description: A utility class providing helper methods for handling files and related HTTP responses in the context of Feign API calls for the Fineract project. Includes methods to determine media type based on file extension, extract filenames from response headers, and probe content types of files.

classes.name: FeignParts
classes.description: A final utility class containing static methods for file and response processing in Feign API interactions within the Fineract client.

methods.name: mediaType
methods.description: Determines the media type string based on a file's extension. Returns null if the extension is not recognized.

methods.name: fileName
methods.description: Extracts the filename from the Content-Disposition header in an HTTP response, if present.

methods.name: probeContentType
methods.description: Probes the content type of a file using the system's file type detection or falls back to mediaType method, returning 'application/octet-stream' if undetermined.
